scenes.say: Ever wonder why cloud warehouses and lakehouses split storage from compute? What’s the big deal?

scenes.label: Elasticity
scenes.sub: Scale compute up or down without touching stored data.
scenes.say: With separation, you can scale compute up or down without messing with your stored data. That’s real elasticity.
Storage keeps your data safe and cheap. Compute handles queries and can flex as needed. You optimize each for cost and performance.
In Snowflake, your data sits in cloud storage. Compute happens in virtual warehouses you can resize or pause anytime. Data stays safe no matter what.

scenes.question: Does scaling compute affect stored data?
scenes.right: No, storage and compute are independent. Resizing compute doesn’t touch your stored data.
scenes.say: Here’s a common interview trap: Does scaling compute affect your stored data? The answer is no. Storage and compute are totally independent.
